findings.region: Führungskraft lane, directly right of the sticky lane-header column
findings.what: The pan stops with the 'Abrechnung korrekt?' card partly under the sticky lane-header column. Only 'nung korrekt?' and 'heidung' can be read, and this lasts for the whole hold.

findings.region: Führungskraft lane, dashed return line left of the cards
findings.what: The 'Rücksprung' label is no longer on screen at the end of the pan. It has scrolled under the lane-header column, so only the bare dashed line is left.

findings.region: Around the click point on the Reisekostenabrechnung card
findings.what: A dark disc covers the card text around the click ('ab; nach Prüfung' disappears), and a dark arc shows above the card's top edge. The disc stays after the ripple has faded (#20). It is confined to the ripple area.

findings.region: Mitarbeiter lane of the vertical swimlane view
findings.what: Half-painted frame: the arrows and the gateway are drawn but the step cards are missing. The cards are there in the next tile (+2 frames).

findings.region: Bottom of the diagram, the automation hint next to the notation legend
findings.what: The orange hint 'Noch keine automatisierten Schritte — Automatisierungspotenzial' overlaps the NOTATION legend bar, so both are partly covered.
